notablePrerequisites:
Tradewind Rider does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other untapped creatures.
description:
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it and two other untapped creatures you control, returning The One Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.
